LanguageData.DS_DesignatorSafeAreaExpand_Desc: Paint cells where colonists using Flee to safe area can take shelter. The global safe-area layer can overlap stockpiles, growing zones and regular allowed areas.
LanguageData.DS_DesignatorSafeAreaClear_Desc: Remove cells from the global safe-area layer.
LanguageData.DS_Message_NoSafeAreaConfigured: Cannot flee to a safe area: no safe cells have been painted.
LanguageData.DS_Message_NoReachableSafeCell: Cannot flee to a safe area: no painted safe cell is reachable.
LanguageData.DS_Alert_NoSafeArea_Explanation:
At least one colonist is configured to flee to a safe area, but no safe cells have been painted on their map.
Use Architect → Zone → Expand safe area to paint one or more shelters.
